local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG local function verifyArtworkFace(part,face,asset)
 assert(part and part:IsA('BasePart') and part.Transparency<1,'art host missing or hidden')
 assert(type(asset)=='string' and asset~='','configured art missing')
 local images,decals=0,0
 for _,d in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
  if d:IsA('SurfaceGui') and d.Face==face and d.Enabled then
   for _,image in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do
    if image:IsA('ImageLabel') and image.Visible and image.ImageTransparency<1 and image.Image==asset then images+=1 end
   end
  elseif d:IsA('Decal') and d.Face==face and d.Texture==asset and d.Transparency<1 then decals+=1 end
 end
 assert(images==1 and decals==1,'expected one visible image and decal on '..tostring(face)..' for '..asset)
 return true
end
local function verifyBothFaceText(part,title)
 assert(part and part:IsA('BasePart') and part.Transparency<1,'text sign missing or hidden')
 for _,face in ipairs({Enum.NormalId.Front,Enum.NormalId.Back}) do
  local found=false
  for _,surface in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
   if surface:IsA('SurfaceGui') and surface.Face==face and surface.Enabled then
    for _,label in ipairs(surface:GetDescendants()) do if label:IsA('TextLabel') and label.Visible and label.TextTransparency<1 and string.find(string.upper(label.Text),string.upper(title),1,true) then found=true end end
   end
  end
  assert(found,'visible sign text missing on '..tostring(face)..': '..title)
 end
 return true
end
local function verifyPremiumDisplays(root,G)
 local city=root.Polish['City Decor'] local count=0 local tiers={}
 assert(#G.PremiumFists>0,'empty premium catalog')
 for _,item in ipairs(G.PremiumFists) do
  local stand=assert(root.Interactables:FindFirstChild(item.name..' Stand'),'configured stand missing '..item.name)
  assert(stand:IsA('BasePart') and stand.Anchored and stand.CanQuery and stand:GetAttribute('PremiumOnly')==true,'stand is not an actual premium interaction')
  local display=assert(city:FindFirstChild(item.name..' Creator Store Display'),'showcase missing '..item.name)
  local visible=0 for _,d in ipairs(display:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('BasePart') and d.Transparency<1 then visible+=1 end end
  assert(visible>0 and display:GetAttribute('VisualRole')=='PremiumFistShowcase' and display:GetAttribute('PremiumTier')==item.tier,'showcase geometry/tier missing')
  verifyBothFaceText(city:FindFirstChild(item.name..' Armory Nameplate'),item.displayName or item.name)
  assert(not tiers[item.tier],'duplicate premium tier') tiers[item.tier]=true count+=1
 end
 return count
end

local count=verifyPremiumDisplays(root,G) local sign=root['Fist Shop Sign'] verifyArtworkFace(sign,Enum.NormalId.Front,G.GeneratedGraphics.HeroCityHUDAtlas) verifyArtworkFace(sign,Enum.NormalId.Back,G.HeroCityPixelUI.SmashBillboard)

local function combatNumber(value)
 value=tonumber(value) or 0
 for _,unit in ipairs({{1e12,'T'},{1e9,'B'},{1e6,'M'},{1e3,'K'}}) do if math.abs(value)>=unit[1] then return string.format('%.1f%s',value/unit[1],unit[2]) end end
 return tostring(math.floor(value+.5))
end
local function replicatedPower(p,G)
 local function read(name,fallback) local value=p.RPGStats:FindFirstChild(name) or p.leaderstats:FindFirstChild(name) return value and value.Value or fallback end
 return G.EffectivePower(read('Power',0),read('FistMultiplier',1),read('PetMultiplier',0),read('Rebirths',0),read('FistMastery',1),read('HonorPowerBonus',0))
end
local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation
local function assertContained(container,object)
 assert(object and object:IsA('GuiObject') and object.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and object.AbsoluteSize.Y>0,'missing rendered rectangle')
 local a,b=container.AbsolutePosition,container.AbsoluteSize local p,s=object.AbsolutePosition,object.AbsoluteSize
 assert(p.X>=a.X-1 and p.Y>=a.Y-1 and p.X+s.X<=a.X+b.X+1 and p.Y+s.Y<=a.Y+b.Y+1,'rendered bounds outside safe host: '..object.Name)
end
local function effectivelyVisible(object)
 local node=object while node do if node:IsA('GuiObject') and not node.Visible then return false end node=node.Parent end return true
end

local function combatNumber(value)
 value=tonumber(value) or 0

 return tostring(math.floor(value+.5))
end
local function verifyCombatPresentation(actual,expected)
 assert(actual.kind==expected.kind and actual.target==expected.target and actual.canonical==expected.canonical,'HUD target/canonical identity disagrees with actual target')
 assert(actual.wallVisible==(expected.kind=='Wall') and actual.bossVisible==(expected.kind=='Boss'),'wall/boss presentation is not exclusive')
 assert(actual.title==expected.title,'HUD display title/phase/weak-point guidance incorrect')
 assert(math.abs(actual.fill-expected.fill)<.001,'HUD fill disagrees with actual HP')
 assert(actual.detail:find(expected.hpText,1,true)==1,'HUD HP numbers disagree with actual target')
 assert(actual.outlineCount==1,'owned target outline duplicated or missing')
 if expected.kind=='Wall' then
  assert(actual.hits==expected.hits and actual.detail==expected.hpText..'  |  ~'..combatNumber(expected.hits)..' hits','HUD hit estimate disagrees with authoritative effective power')
  assert(actual.outlineEnabled and actual.outlineTarget==expected.target,'outline lost actual live target')
 else
  assert(not actual.outlineEnabled and actual.outlineTarget=='','boss retains stale wall outline')
  if expected.countdown then
   local seconds=tonumber(actual.detail:match('  |  SHOCKWAVE (%d+)s$'))
   assert(seconds and seconds>=0 and math.abs(seconds-expected.countdown)<=1 and actual.detail==expected.hpText..'  |  SHOCKWAVE '..seconds..'s','HUD countdown disagrees with replicated attack deadline')
  else assert(actual.detail==expected.hpText..'  |  TARGET RED CORES','idle boss weak-point guidance incorrect') end
 end
 assert(actual.distance<= (expected.kind=='Wall' and 24 or 55),'target outside presentation range')
 assert(actual.textFits and actual.safeBounds,'actual HUD text/bounds clipped')
 return true
end

 local function read(name,fallback) local value=p.RPGStats:FindFirstChild(name) or p.leaderstats:FindFirstChild(name) return value and value.Value or fallback end
 return G.EffectivePower(read('Power',0),read('FistMultiplier',1),read('PetMultiplier',0),read('Rebirths',0),read('FistMastery',1),read('HonorPowerBonus',0))
end
local function observeCombatHUD(g,p,target,kind)
 local frame=kind=='Wall' and g.TargetWallHUD or g.BossHUD
 local title=kind=='Wall' and frame.TargetTitle or frame.BossTitle
 local detail=kind=='Wall' and frame.TargetDetail or frame.BossSubtitle
 local track=kind=='Wall' and frame.HealthTrack or frame.BossHealthTrack
 local fill=kind=='Wall' and track.HealthFill or track.BossHealthFill
 local outline,count=nil,0
 for _,item in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do if item.Name=='Local Target Highlight' and item:IsA('Highlight') then outline=item count+=1 end end
 local safe=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD local a,s=safe.AbsolutePosition,safe.AbsoluteSize local b,z=frame.AbsolutePosition,frame.AbsoluteSize
 return {kind=g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDKind'),target=g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDTarget'),canonical=g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDCanonicalTarget'),hits=g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDHitEstimate'),wallVisible=g.TargetWallHUD.Visible,bossVisible=g.BossHUD.Visible,title=title.Text,detail=detail.Text,fill=fill.Size.X.Scale,outlineCount=count,outlineEnabled=outline and outline.Enabled==true,outlineTarget=outline and outline.Adornee and outline.Adornee.Name or '',distance=(target.Position-p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude,textFits=title.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and detail.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and title.TextBounds.X<=title.AbsoluteSize.X+1 and title.TextBounds.Y<=title.AbsoluteSize.Y+1 and detail.TextBounds.X<=detail.AbsoluteSize.X+1 and detail.TextBounds.Y<=detail.AbsoluteSize.Y+1,safeBounds=z.X>0 and z.Y>0 and b.X>=a.X-1 and b.Y>=a.Y-1 and b.X+z.X<=a.X+s.X+1 and b.Y+z.Y<=a.Y+s.Y+1}
end

 local deadline=os.clock()+4
 repeat task.wait(.05) until (g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDKind')==kind and g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDTarget')==name) or os.clock()>deadline
 assert(g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDKind')==kind and g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDTarget')==name,'bounded HUD target observation timed out')
end

local b=assert(workspace.PunchWallRPG['Depth Blocks']:FindFirstChild(p:GetAttribute('SmashHUDConsumerIronTarget')),'fixture block missing')

local def=assert(G.Walls[b:GetAttribute('MaterialTier')]) local hp,maxHP=b:GetAttribute('HP'),b:GetAttribute('MaxHP')

 if expected.kind=='Wall' then
  assert(actual.hits==expected.hits and actual.detail==expected.hpText..'  |  ~'..combatNumber(expected.hits)..' hits','HUD hit estimate disagrees with authoritative effective power')
  assert(actual.outlineEnabled and actual.outlineTarget==expected.target,'outline lost actual live target')
 else
  assert(not actual.outlineEnabled and actual.outlineTarget=='','boss retains stale wall outline')
  if expected.countdown then
   local seconds=tonumber(actual.detail:match('  |  SHOCKWAVE (%d+)s$'))
   assert(seconds and seconds>=0 and math.abs(seconds-expected.countdown)<=1 and actual.detail==expected.hpText..'  |  SHOCKWAVE '..seconds..'s','HUD countdown disagrees with replicated attack deadline')
  else assert(actual.detail==expected.hpText..'  |  TARGET RED CORES','idle boss weak-point guidance incorrect') end
 end
 assert(actual.distance<= (expected.kind=='Wall' and 24 or 55),'target outside presentation range')
 assert(actual.textFits and actual.safeBounds,'actual HUD text/bounds clipped')
 return true
end
local function observeCombatHUD(g,p,target,kind)
 local frame=kind=='Wall' and g.TargetWallHUD or g.BossHUD
 local title=kind=='Wall' and frame.TargetTitle or frame.BossTitle
 local detail=kind=='Wall' and frame.TargetDetail or frame.BossSubtitle
 local track=kind=='Wall' and frame.HealthTrack or frame.BossHealthTrack
 local fill=kind=='Wall' and track.HealthFill or track.BossHealthFill
 local outline,count=nil,0
 for _,item in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do if item.Name=='Local Target Highlight' and item:IsA('Highlight') then outline=item count+=1 end end
 local safe=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD local a,s=safe.AbsolutePosition,safe.AbsoluteSize local b,z=frame.AbsolutePosition,frame.AbsoluteSize
 return {kind=g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDKind'),target=g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDTarget'),canonical=g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDCanonicalTarget'),hits=g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDHitEstimate'),wallVisible=g.TargetWallHUD.Visible,bossVisible=g.BossHUD.Visible,title=title.Text,detail=detail.Text,fill=fill.Size.X.Scale,outlineCount=count,outlineEnabled=outline and outline.Enabled==true,outlineTarget=outline and outline.Adornee and outline.Adornee.Name or '',distance=(target.Position-p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude,textFits=title.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and detail.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and title.TextBounds.X<=title.AbsoluteSize.X+1 and title.TextBounds.Y<=title.AbsoluteSize.Y+1 and detail.TextBounds.X<=detail.AbsoluteSize.X+1 and detail.TextBounds.Y<=detail.AbsoluteSize.Y+1,safeBounds=z.X>0 and z.Y>0 and b.X>=a.X-1 and b.Y>=a.Y-1 and b.X+z.X<=a.X+s.X+1 and b.Y+z.Y<=a.Y+s.Y+1}
end
local function awaitCombatTarget(g,kind,name)
 g.PunchWallClientAutomation:Invoke('CloseMenus')
 local deadline=os.clock()+4
 repeat task.wait(.05) until (g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDKind')==kind and g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDTarget')==name) or os.clock()>deadline
 assert(g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDKind')==kind and g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDTarget')==name,'bounded HUD target observation timed out')
end

local b=workspace.PunchWallRPG.Walls['Titan Server Wall'] awaitCombatTarget(g,'Boss',b.Name)
local hp,maxHP=b:GetAttribute('HP'),b:GetAttribute('MaxHP') local phase=b:GetAttribute('BossPhase') local nextAt=b:GetAttribute('NextAttackAt')
assert(phase==1 and not b:GetAttribute('Broken') and hp>0 and maxHP>0,'actual encounter phase changed')
assert(nextAt==0,'idle encounter countdown unexpectedly armed')

local actual=observeCombatHUD(g,p,b,'Boss') verifyCombatPresentation(actual,expected)
return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,title=actual.title,subtitle=actual.detail,phase=phase,actualFill=actual.fill,expectedFill=expected.fill,actualBoundsSafe=actual.safeBounds})
